_comment: LIVE pack changelog for the main-menu Announcements screen (Core reads this; overrides the jar-bundled fallback). Newest entry first. Edit per release. Keep lines short & player-facing.

entries.title: The Big One — museum, pets, trade & a fresh menu
added: Museum photography — take & frame real photos (Exposure)
Plushies + tameable hamster pets to keep you company
Paintings, furniture with display cases & thousands of build blocks
Buy & sell with airships (Create Aeronautics: Delivery Required)
In-game chat translator + emojis in chat
GTA-style cinematic teleport transitions & more armor trims
Cozy ambient wildlife, cooler explosions & extra visual polish
This Announcements screen — see what changed every update
fixed: Create machines & lasers now render correctly with shaders on
Loading-screen cogwheels are now clearly visible
Spectator mode can fly through blocks again
